creator: Tomer Rafael Angel
scope_note: All 34 records and 11 project scopes from the selected 5 October snapshot, plus 8 recent additions and 4 additional project streams. Not every private conversation, file or operational task. This catalog does not certify application behavior or deployment.

source_snapshot.title: TRA_Knowledge_v1.0_2026-10-05.json
source_snapshot.note: Original remains in the owner's Library. Original record texts and IDs are retained here; evidence locators and full provenance remain in that source.

records.title: Canonical names
records.en: Use Tomer Angel as the public-facing display name, TA as the personal monogram, and TRA as the umbrella brand. Keep Tomer Rafael Angel for formal or full creator attribution. A display-name update does not rename every project or change source authorship.
records.he: שֵׁם הַתְּצוּגָה הוּא Tomer Angel; הַסֵּמֶל הָאִישִׁי הוּא TA; מוֹתָג־הָעַל הוּא TRA. הַשֵּׁם הַמָּלֵא נִשְׁמָר לְיִחוּס רִשְׁמִי.

records.title: Purpose
records.en: TRA connects music, culture, society and reality through participation, learning and practical creation. Music = Culture = Society = Reality is a statement of values, not a scientific equation. The related Music = Culture = Society = Identity = Progress formulation is preserved as an additional expression of the vision.
records.he: מוּזִיקָה = תַּרְבּוּת = חֶבְרָה = מְצִיאוּת. זֶהוּ חָזוֹן עֶרְכִּי שֶׁל הַקְשָׁבָה, לְמִידָה וְחִבּוּר אֱנוֹשִׁי, לֹא מִשְׁוָאָה מַדָּעִית.

records.title: Keep the two Tomers distinct
records.en: Tomer Angel / Tomer Rafael Angel is the creator and organizer. Tomer Yaakov Mizrahi is the person remembered in the separate memorial project. Shared branding never merges their identities, biographies, voices or credits.
records.he: תּוֹמֶר אַנְגֶ׳ל וְתּוֹמֶר יַעֲקֹב מִזְרָחִי ז״ל הֵם שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שׁוֹנִים. שׁוֹמְרִים עַל הַזֶּהוּת, עַל הַסִּפּוּר וְעַל הַקְּרֶדִיט שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד.

records.title: Attribution and logo boundary
records.en: Retain the requested footer: © 2026 Tomer Rafael Angel. All rights reserved. Third-party works retain their own credits and rights. A request to designate an official logo is recorded, but this package neither selects nor verifies a master logo asset.
records.he: שׁוֹמְרִים עַל יִחוּס הַיּוֹצֵר וְעַל זְכֻיּוֹת שֶׁל יוֹצְרִים אֲחֵרִים. קֹבֶץ לוֹגוֹ רִשְׁמִי לֹא אוּמַת בַּעֲבוֹדָה הַזֹּאת.

records.title: TRA ART TRY
records.en: TRA ART TRY is the named constitutional framework. Its newer provisions extend prior principles; they do not erase the earlier constitution. Recording a principle is not proof that every site or game implements it.
records.he: TRA ART TRY הִיא מִסְגֶּרֶת הַחוּקָה. כָּל תּוֹסֶפֶת מַרְחִיבָה אֶת הַקַּיָּם, וְאֵינָהּ מוֹחֶקֶת אֶת הַמָּקוֹר.

records.title: Reality first
records.en: Be reliable, honest, precise and willing to cross-check relevant information. Distinguish facts, interpretation, mythology, demonstrations, proposals and unknowns. Never turn a convincing description into a claim of completed work.
records.he: אֱמֶת לִפְנֵי רֹשֶׁם. מַבְחִינִים בֵּין עוּבְדָּה, פַּרְשָׁנוּת, הַצָּעָה וּמֵידָע חָסֵר; כְּשֶׁאֵין רְאָיָה, אוֹמְרִים זֹאת.

records.title: Preserve while improving
records.en: Follow Source → Preservation → Improvement → New version. Keep historical content and decisions, while applying the latest explicit correction to new work. Do not overwrite dates, identifiers or third-party credits to make a new presentation look consistent.
records.he: מָקוֹר ← שִׁמּוּר ← שִׁפּוּר ← גִּרְסָה חֲדָשָׁה. מְשַׁדְרְגִים בְּלִי לִמְחֹק הִיסְטוֹרְיָה, וּפוֹעֲלִים לְפִי הַהוֹרָאָה הַמְּפֹרֶשֶׁת הָאַחֲרוֹנָה.

records.title: Listen with patience
records.en: Listen before judging, speaking or acting. Let people finish. Participation may mean singing, playing, speaking or simply listening. Playback should be a choice, with pause and volume control; patient listening is not a requirement to disclose information or endure an unwanted activity.
records.he: מַקְשִׁיבִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּמְאַפְשְׁרִים לָאָדָם לְסַיֵּם. אֶפְשָׁר לָשִׁיר, לְנַגֵּן, לְדַבֵּר אוֹ רַק לְהַקְשִׁיב; מֻתָּר לַעֲצֹר.

records.title: Purpose, relevance, quality and simplicity
records.en: Ask what the experience is for, whom it serves, and how it works. Keep the core understandable across generations and reduce unnecessary effort. The 999/1000 quality goal is an aspiration until a defined test and measured result support an actual score.
records.he: תַּכְלִית, רֵלֵוַנְטִיּוּת, אֵיכוּת וּפַשְׁטוּת. הַיַּעַד 999/1000 אֵינוֹ צִיּוּן שֶׁנִּמְדַּד; תּוֹצָאָה דּוֹרֶשֶׁת בְּדִיקָה וּרְאָיָה.

records.title: Practical, incremental progress
records.en: Retain the established ideas of simplicity, minimum effort for a useful result, DIY, moving forward without erasing history, and making each step matter. These are working principles, not permission to skip consent, evidence or testing.
records.he: פַּשְׁטוּת, עֲשִׂיָּה עַצְמִית וְהִתְקַדְּמוּת בִּצְעָדִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם מַשְׁמָעוּת. לֹא מְקַצְּרִים דֶּרֶךְ עַל חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַסְכָּמָה אוֹ אֱמֶת.

records.title: Independent workstreams and silence
records.en: When several tasks are requested, preserve each as a separate workstream rather than silently dropping some. Where useful, give each two concrete outputs or actions. Silence alone does not cancel an active task, but it is never authorization for a new external action.
records.he: מְטַפְּלִים בְּכָל מְשִׂימָה בִּנְפָרָד. שְׁתִיקָה אֵינָהּ בִּטּוּל שֶׁל מְשִׂימָה, וְאֵינָהּ אִשּׁוּר לִפְעֻלָּה חִיצוֹנִית חֲדָשָׁה.

records.title: Two natural languages
records.en: Hebrew is the base language; use English when it serves the task or is requested. Preserve each language’s own grammar, typography and sentence structure instead of mechanically mirroring the other.
records.he: עִבְרִית הִיא שְׂפַת הַבָּסִיס; אַנְגְּלִית מִשְׁתַּלֶּבֶת לְפִי הַצֹּרֶךְ. לְכָל שָׂפָה תַּחְבִּיר טִבְעִי וּמִבְנֶה מִשֶּׁלָּהּ.

records.title: Hebrew niqqud
records.en: Default to fully pointed Hebrew in TRA games, apps and sites. Do not alter code, URLs, IDs, filenames or brand identity to add niqqud. This is a content requirement; this package does not claim all existing interfaces already comply.
records.he: בְּמִשְׂחֲקֵי TRA, בַּיִּשּׂוּמוֹנִים וּבָאֲתָרִים, עִבְרִית מֻצֶּגֶת בְּנִקּוּד מָלֵא כִּבְרֵרַת מֶחְדָּל, בְּלִי לִפְגֹּעַ בַּקּוֹד אוֹ בְּמִזְהִים.

records.title: Every device eligible
records.en: Design for broad accessibility, progressive enhancement and a useful offline path. Recorded target environments include Windows 7, Android 10 and the user’s stated iOS ≤ 26 target. These are requested compatibility targets, not certifications that every device, browser or service works.
records.he: כָּל מַכְשִׁיר זַכַּאי לְהִשְׁתַּתֵּף. מְתַכְנְנִים נְגִישׁוּת וּמַסְלוּל שִׁמּוּשִׁי לְלֹא רֶשֶׁת; תְּאִימוּת נִבְדֶּקֶת, וְלֹא רַק מֻבְטַחַת.

records.title: History & Music — Tomer Angel 2026
records.en: Music is part of the main TRA historical record, not a substitute for it. Preserve the exact title History & Music — Tomer Angel 2026. Attach music to a period, project or event only when the relationship is documented; label later additions as present-day curation.
records.he: הַמּוּזִיקָה הִיא חֵלֶק מִן הַהִיסְטוֹרְיָה שֶׁל TRA. שׁוֹמְרִים עַל הַמָּקוֹר וּמַבְחִינִים בֵּין קֶשֶׁר מְתֹעָד לִבְחִירַת אֹצְרוּת חֲדָשָׁה.

records.title: Music metadata and permitted playback
records.en: For a music-history link, record the work, artist, period or project, source and relationship type. Leave missing facts unknown. Check the source and permitted use before embedding or redistributing audio; a song link or a short duration alone does not establish permission under TRA’s publication rules.
records.he: לְכָל יְצִירָה שׁוֹמְרִים שֵׁם, יוֹצֵר, מָקוֹר וְסוּג קֶשֶׁר. מֵידָע חָסֵר נִשְׁאָר לֹא יָדוּעַ; הַשְׁמָעָה מְחַיֶּבֶת בְּדִיקַת הַרְשָׁאָה.

records.title: Europe is Music
records.en: Preserve Europe is Music and Europe = Music = Culture = People = Connection as an additional TRA principle. Where relevant, represent Europe through varied musical traditions, styles, instruments and people. Extend cultural connections without replacing existing TRA principles or erasing other cultures.
records.he: אֵירוֹפָּה הִיא מוּזִיקָה: מוּזִיקָה, תַּרְבּוּת, אֲנָשִׁים וְקֶשֶׁר. מוֹסִיפִים מַבָּט רַב־תַּרְבּוּתִי בְּלִי לִמְחֹק זֶהוּיוֹת אוֹ עֶקְרוֹנוֹת קוֹדְמִים.

records.title: Music and mathematics
records.en: The user’s music-and-mathematics idea connects rhythm, patterns, structure and creative flow. Treat the ecosystem/harmony language as a creative organizing analogy, not evidence that a numerical model or an audio engine has already been implemented.
records.he: מוּזִיקָה וּמָתֵמָטִיקָה נִפְגָּשׁוֹת בְּקֶצֶב, בְּדְפוּסִים וּבְמִבְנֶה. זֶהוּ כִּוּוּן יְצִירָתִי; מִמּוּשׁ טֶכְנִי עֲדַיִן דּוֹרֵשׁ בְּדִיקָה.

records.title: Ten cards to win, with a fair final round
records.en: The documented family HITSTER winning target is 10 cards. When a team reaches it, finish the current round only for teams still owed a turn. Then announce the actual team name, or all qualifying teams in a tie. Do not restore the older 18-card target while transferring another feature.
records.he: יַעַד הַנִּצָּחוֹן הוּא 10 קְלָפִים. מַשְׁלִימִים אֶת הַסֶּבֶב לַקְּבוּצוֹת שֶׁטֶּרֶם שִׂחֲקוּ, וְרַק אָז מַכְרִיזִים עַל הַתּוֹצָאָה.

records.title: Ten lives is a separate requirement
records.en: A newer request gives each team 10 persistent lives. Lives are not the same as the 10-card winning target. The relationship between lives and older stars/tokens remains unresolved in the evidence reviewed here; no code migration or current deployment is certified by this knowledge file.
records.he: הַבַּקָּשָׁה לְ־10 חַיִּים לְכָל קְבוּצָה נִפְרֶדֶת מִיַּעַד שֶׁל 10 קְלָפִים. הַקֶּשֶׁר לְמַנְגְּנוֹן הַכּוֹכָבִים הַקּוֹדֵם לֹא אוּמַת.

records.title: Reveal is not add; songs do not repeat
records.en: Keep Reveal year separate from Add song to timeline. Do not expose the answer or a year range prematurely on the shared screen. Retain the requested global no-repeat behavior, team names, Continue versus Reset choice and confirmation for destructive timeline actions.
records.he: חֲשִׂיפַת הַשָּׁנָה וְהוֹסָפָה לְצִיר הַזְּמַן הֵן פְּעֻלּוֹת נִפְרָדוֹת. לֹא מְגַלִּים תְּשׁוּבָה מֻקְדָּם, וְלֹא חוֹזְרִים עַל שִׁיר שֶׁכְּבָר שֻׂחַק.

records.title: Audio and catalog requirements, not guarantees
records.en: The requested experience plays inside TRA rather than depending on a broken playback button. A 30-second preview is a recurring requirement; full-song use requires an appropriate permitted source. HITSTER 888, 999, 590-card reports and later catalog targets must not be treated as a single verified inventory. Source data and device playback need separate checks.
records.he: הַהַשְׁמָעָה הַמְּבֻקֶּשֶׁת הִיא בְּתוֹךְ TRA. שֵׁם מַהֲדוּרָה אֵינוֹ סְפִירַת שִׁירִים מְאֻמֶּתֶת, וְכַפְתּוֹר נִרְאֶה אֵינוֹ הוֹכָחָה לְשֶׁמַע תַּקִּין.

records.title: Catalog curation exclusions
records.en: The user requested removing Eyal Golan and Michael Jackson from the curated HITSTER song catalog. This is a content-selection instruction, not a claim about the current dataset or a judgment added by this knowledge package.
records.he: מְכַבְּדִים אֶת הַחְרָגוֹת הַתֹּכֶן שֶׁהַמִּשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בִּקֵּשׁ; אֵין כָּאן אִשּׁוּר שֶׁהַמַּאֲגָר הַפָּעִיל כְּבָר עֻדְכַּן.

records.title: Quiet Rule remains a design rule
records.en: The Quiet Rule proposes rewarding quieter, attentive participation: lower dB → more points. Do not describe an unverified phone reading as a calibrated measurement or claim the scoring exists. The listening principle remains subject to consent and accessibility.
records.he: כְּלַל הַשֶּׁקֶט מְבַקֵּשׁ לְעוֹדֵד הַקְשָׁבָה. מְדִידַת עָצְמָה וְנִקּוּד אוֹטוֹמָטִי אֵינָם מְאֻמָּתִים כָּאן.

records.title: P = 10G is a planning formula
records.en: In the recorded scalable planning model, P = 10G: four groups correspond to 40 planned participants, five to 50, six to 60, and twenty to 200. These are group/participant quantities, not age ranges or measured attendance.
records.he: בְּמוֹדֶל הַתִּכְנוּן P = 10G: אַרְבַּע קְבוּצוֹת הֵן 40 מִשְׁתַּתְּפִים מְתֻכְנָנִים. אֵלֶּה אֵינָם טְוָחֵי גִּיל אוֹ נְתוּנֵי הַגָּעָה בְּפֹעַל.

records.title: Keep demonstration and generation models separate
records.en: A separate Kfar Blum demonstration document uses 100 fictitious participants in four groups of 25; its publication was explicitly paused in that record. It is not the P = 10G model or a real roster. Age-based answering stages are another mode entirely and are not a universal TRA eligibility policy.
records.he: מוֹדֶל הַדְגָּמָה, מוֹדֶל קְבוּצוֹת וּמַצָּב דּוֹרוֹת הֵם מַסְלוּלִים נִפְרָדִים. לֹא מְעַרְבְּבִים אֲנָשִׁים בְּדֻיִּים עִם רְשִׁימָה אֲמִתִּית.

records.title: From consumption to usable knowledge
records.en: The TRA learning workflow asks a question, studies a short section, recalls without the source, explains or performs, revisits over time and applies the idea. Mark knowledge as learned based on an observable explanation or task, not merely on time spent reading. This records TRA’s chosen workflow rather than independently reviewing learning-science claims.
records.he: לוֹמְדִים, סוֹגְרִים אֶת הַמָּקוֹר, שׁוֹלְפִים מֵהַזִּכָּרוֹן וּמְיַשְּׂמִים. הִתְקַדְּמוּת נִבְחֶנֶת בְּמָה שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר לְהַסְבִּיר וּלְבַצֵּעַ.

records.title: Cross-disciplinary interpretation
records.en: Relevant connections may draw on Jewish texts, wider philosophy, psychology and music. Attribute quotations and ideas accurately; distinguish a source’s statement from a new analogy or interpretation. Do not turn cultural material into invented history or a universal obligation.
records.he: מְחַבְּרִים בֵּין מְקוֹרוֹת וּבֵין תְּחוּמֵי דַּעַת, וּמַבְחִינִים בֵּין צִטּוּט לְפַרְשָׁנוּת. קֶשֶׁר יְצִירָתִי אֵינוֹ עוּבְדָּה הִיסְטוֹרִית.

records.title: Public knowledge is not the private archive
records.en: Keep owner-only, authorized-group and public material distinct. Public extracts exclude private health, family, financial, account and coordination records. Broad requests such as “all TRA knowledge” do not automatically grant permission to publish every source. A hidden link is not an access-control system.
records.he: יֶדַע צִבּוּרִי אֵינוֹ אַרְכִיּוֹן פְּרָטִי. מַפְרִידִים הַרְשָׁאוֹת וּמַסִּירִים פְּרָטִים רְגִישִׁים; קִשּׁוּר נִסְתָּר אֵינוֹ מַנְגְּנוֹן הֲגָנָה.

records.title: Memorial approval and AI identity
records.en: Use memorial stories, images and recordings only with approval for the intended use. An AI assistant must identify itself and answer from approved content; it must not invent memories or impersonate the deceased. Private attendance and ride data are not public memorial knowledge.
records.he: תֹּכֶן זִכָּרוֹן נִכְלָל רַק בְּאִשּׁוּר לַשִּׁמּוּשׁ הַמְּיֹעָד. עוֹזֵר בִּינָה מְלָאכוּתִית מִזְדַּהֶה כְּכָזֶה וְאֵינוֹ מַמְצִיא זִכְרוֹנוֹת.

records.title: Community music is not a clinical promise
records.en: TRA’s community and music activities aim at creative and social connection. In its public framing, do not present participation as a diagnosis, medical treatment or a guaranteed therapeutic outcome. This boundary coexists with the broader interest in well-being and care.
records.he: מוּזִיקָה וּקְהִלָּה מְיֹעָדוֹת לְחִבּוּר וּלְיְצִירָה. אֵין לְהַצִּיג פְּעִילוּת קְהִלָּתִית כְּהַבְטָחָה לְטִפּוּל אוֹ לְתוֹצָאָה רְפוּאִית.

records.title: State every action accurately
records.en: Separate idea, decision, draft, implementation, code test, browser/device test and publication. A commit is not a deployment; a successful deployment is not proof that every interaction or integration works. Report only the state supported by evidence.
records.he: רַעְיוֹן, הַחְלָטָה, טְיוּטָה, מִמּוּשׁ, בְּדִיקָה וּפִרְסוּם הֵם מַצָּבִים שׁוֹנִים. מְדַוְּחִים רַק עַל מַה שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ רְאָיָה.

records.title: Release gates and explicit authorization
records.en: The documented release rule requires passing CI and checking the live HTTP result. Preserve a publication pause until an appropriate new instruction resolves it. Publishing, emailing, merging or sharing must not be silently inferred from a request to generate knowledge.
records.he: לִפְנֵי פִּרְסוּם בּוֹדְקִים אֶת הַקּוֹד וְאֶת הַתּוֹצָאָה הַחַיָּה. בַּקָּשָׁה לְהַכִּין יֶדַע אֵינָהּ הוֹרָאָה לִשְׁלֹחַ, לְמַזֵּג אוֹ לְפַרְסֵם.

records.title: Integrations must be verified individually
records.en: A requested connection to GitHub, music services, analytics or AI tools does not prove an active integration. Each requires an appropriate authorized connection and a checked result. This package does not synchronize services or grant permissions.
records.he: בַּקָּשַׁת חִבּוּר אֵינָהּ הוֹכָחָה לְחִבּוּר פָּעִיל. כָּל שֵׁרוּת דּוֹרֵשׁ הַרְשָׁאָה וּבְדִיקָה נִפְרֶדֶת.

additions.title: TRA212 identity
additions.en: TRA212 is the requested consolidation layer within TRA. Preserve TRA, TRA ART TRY, Tomer Angel and full creator attribution; do not rename original sources.
additions.he: TRA212 הִיא שִׁכְבַת רִכּוּז בְּתוֹךְ TRA; שְׁמוֹת הַמָּקוֹר וְהַיִּחוּס נִשְׁמָרִים.

additions.title: Languages, dialects and accents
additions.en: Retain English, Spanish, French and Italian as lesson-pack requirements while keeping a wider catalog separate from lesson availability. Model language, dialect/accent, grapheme, sequence, IPA, word and Archive / Language / Model / Learning / Adaptation tags. Complete world-language coverage is not claimed.
additions.he: מַפְרִידִים בֵּין קָטָלוֹג שָׂפוֹת, נִיבִים וּמִבְטָאִים לְבֵין שִׁעוּרִים זְמִינִים; כִּסּוּי מָלֵא לֹא אוּמַת.

additions.title: Learning as a game
additions.en: Keep the requested listening, recall, repetition and music/rhythm learning loop. Cataloging a learning model does not implement a game engine.
additions.he: מַקְשִׁיבִים, שׁוֹלְפִים, חוֹזְרִים וּמְתַרְגְּלִים בְּמִשְׂחָק; מִמּוּשׁ הַמָּנוֹעַ דּוֹרֵשׁ בְּדִיקָה.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context

additions.title: TEAK, transport and weather
additions.en: Include the already linked technology, navigation and weather branches. Refer to the existing pages rather than duplicating or inventing current specifications, forecasts or transit data.
additions.he: מְקַשְּׁרִים לַיֶּדַע הַטֶּכְנוֹלוֹגִי, לַנִּוּוּט וּלְמֶזֶג הָאֲוִיר בְּלִי לְהַמְצִיא נְתוּנִים עַדְכָּנִיִּים.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context

additions.title: Archive instead of silently deleting
additions.en: Preserve source material, version history and superseded decisions; record changes as new entries. Do not interpret archival intent as a request to delete calendar events, files or branches.
additions.he: מְשַׁמְּרִים מְקוֹרוֹת, גִּרְסָאוֹת וְהַחְלָטוֹת; שִׁנּוּי נִרְשָׁם כְּתּוֹסֶפֶת, לֹא כִּמְחִיקָה שְׁקֵטָה.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context

additions.title: Names and shortcuts
additions.en: Recognize TRA, TRa and Tra as display/search aliases. Preserve TRA212 as this hub name. This does not create case-sensitive deployment routes or redirect existing URLs.
additions.he: TRA, TRa ו־Tra הֵם כִּנּוּיֵי תְּצוּגָה וְחִפּוּשׂ; כְּתֹבוֹת הַמָּקוֹר אֵינָן מִשְׁתַּנּוֹת.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context

additions.title: Logo and image archive
additions.en: Keep the request to archive the approved Tomer Angel logo under Image / Logo / TRA. No usable master asset was identified in this task, so no new image is designated official.
additions.he: בַּקָּשַׁת אַרְכִיּוֹן הַלּוֹגוֹ נִשְׁמֶרֶת; קֹבֶץ מָקוֹר מְאֻשָּׁר לֹא אוּמַת וְאֵינוֹ מֻחְלָף.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context

additions.title: Separate review and planning workstreams
additions.en: Keep quality checks, HITSTER, Chess, music/history, research, curation and learning workflows distinct. Preserve each stream and its next step; this catalog does not create reminders, reschedule events, send email or synchronize accounts.
additions.he: שׁוֹמְרִים עַל מַסְלוּלֵי הָעֲבוֹדָה בִּנְפָרָד; הַקָּטָלוֹג אֵינוֹ יוֹצֵר תִּזְכֹּרוֹת אוֹ מְשַׁנֶּה חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת.
additions.source: User instructions available in the 5–6 October 2026 conversation context
